page-break-before: always;"></div><blockquote> <p><strong>Superseded.</strong> Retained as immutable history, not current guidance.</p> </blockquote> <h1 id="call0061-a-goal-is-a-milestone-and-completion-composes-the-gates"><a class="header" href="#call0061-a-goal-is-a-milestone-and-completion-composes-the-gates">call/0061: a goal is a milestone, and completion composes the gates</a></h1> <ul> <li>Status: superseded by the spine</li> <li>Scope: agentic-host, the host-template spine it carries, and host-lifecycle</li> <li>Date: 2026-10-18</li> <li>Relates: plan/0101, <a href="https://github.com/connollydavid/host/issues/26">host#26</a>, call/0060, plan/0042, plan/0041</li> </ul> <h2 id="context-and-problem-21"><a class="header" href="#context-and-problem-21">Context and problem</a></h2> <p>An operator invoked <code>/goal complete plan/0007</code> in a harness where no such command existed; it arrived as prose and the agent improvised a receipt-less channel. The structural vacuum was filed as host#26. The operator ruled the ambition larger than a plugin: a properly worked goal and loop subsystem for the <code>host-*</code> family, designed through the ruling chain (cast, blind external judge, the real weak model), and then ruled again on form: an idiomatic extension of the host methodology, not a port of how other implementations function.</p> <p>The first design was serviceable and foreign-rooted: a Manus-style recitation hook, BDI commitment vocabulary (park as a live state), an authorization token, plugin custom tools, and a closure gate deferred behind a refactor. The cast's second convening, charged with idiom fidelity, found each of these and named the house-native form.</p> <h2 id="decision-53"><a class="header" href="#decision-53">Decision</a></h2> <p>The modality, adopted in bounded form:</p> <ul> <li><strong>A goal is a <code>plan/NNNN</code> milestone.</strong> No new artifact class; the record the rooms already keep is the goal record.</li> <li><strong>State splits by volatility.</strong> Durable facts (set, parked, owed, abandoned, complete) are tracked surfaces the tool already authors: the milestone Status line, <code>[receipt "goal"]</code> stanzas, OWED entries in PLAN.md's closure queue. Machine state (this worktree's execution claim) is a gitignored sidecar re-derivable from the tracked record. One active goal per repo. A lost sidecar under-reports nothing.</li> <li><strong>The audited commit is the authority.</strong> No authorization tokens; the operator-ruling line and the committed declaration are the act. The agent-side path proposes and never mutates.</li> <li><strong>Parking is re-queuing.</strong> The existing queue surfaces own deferral; no parallel state machine.</li> <li><strong>Completion composes the existing gates as subprocesses.</strong> The tool invokes its own verbs and reads their exits; HAZARD lines pass through intact; nothing is weakened, nothing duplicated. Every hazard prints, ordered, each with its exact fix command (the verify-setup shape).</li> <li><strong>The emission reuses house shapes.</strong> NEEDS YOU is a HAZARD line traced to a tracked row; FRONTIER is the <code>tasks</code> frontier line verbatim; the last line is the exact bare command. No inline execution-class markers: the section is the class.</li> <li><strong>The MCP server and the corpus are the seams.</strong> Goal verbs join the shipped MCP server; the goal declaration becomes a corpus surface (the plan/0083 shape), which is the house's recitation answer. Plugin custom tools and compaction re-injection are cut. The seam defers until the core is housegrown, and it renders, never actuates: the turn trigger stays human.</li> <li><strong>The teaching layer states none of this as new.</strong> Per call/0060, the manual section reads present tense; the foreign lineage (Manus, BDI, Anthropic, the harness docs) lives here in the record layer.</li> </ul> <h2 id="consequences-61"><a class="header" href="#consequences-61">Consequences</a></h2> <p>plan/0101 executes this modality. The ledger entry that carries it to adopters must state its applies-alone status, the stamp migration with the re-stamp command and proof an old tool tolerates the new surfaces, the sidecar re-derivation path, and the degraded mode as legible standing without any verb. The weak-model battery gates the emission freeze and reruns on real output. What is deliberately not built: plugin custom tools, a compaction hook, and any actuating kick.</p> </main> <nav class="nav-wrapper" aria-label="Page navigation"> <!-- Mobile navigation buttons --> <div style="clear: both"></div> </nav> </div> </div> <nav class="nav-wide-wrapper" aria-label="Page navigation"> </nav> </div> <script> window.playground_copyable = true; </script> <script src="elasticlunr.min.js"></script> <script src="mark.min.js"></script> <script src="searcher.js"></script> <script src="clipboard.min.js"></script> <script src="highlight.js"></script> <script src="book.js"></script> <!-- Custom JS scripts --> <script> window.addEventListener('load', function() { window.setTimeout(window.print, 100); }); </script> </div> </body> </html>
